_comment: A3 (R32): one single-edit mutant per invariant the A3 cases claim; node tests/a/run-mutants.mjs applies each to a copy and requires a DECLARED case to fail on an assertion.

mutants.what: no configured origin reads as an empty real catalog
mutants.replace: if (baseUrl === null) return { status: "ok", baseUrl: "", models: [] };
cases: no configured origin is unavailable, and nothing is fetched

mutants.what: an error reply is parsed as if it were the list
cases: a gateway that cannot answer is unavailable, never a fixture or an empty catalog

mutants.what: a refused record is dropped and the rest shown
mutants.replace: models = data.flatMap((d: unknown) => { try { return [parsePublishedModel(d)]; } catch { return []; } });
cases: one record the contract refuses fails the whole read: a false ZDR claim is never shown
a gateway that cannot answer is unavailable, never a fixture or an empty catalog

mutants.what: the catalog read sends a credential
cases: the catalog is the published list at <origin>/v1/models, asked without any credential

mutants.what: availability is served from a cache
cases: the catalog is the published list at <origin>/v1/models, asked without any credential

mutants.what: any plain-http origin is accepted
cases: the API origin is https (loopback http for development), with no path, query or credentials

mutants.what: an origin with a path is accepted
cases: the API origin is https (loopback http for development), with no path, query or credentials

mutants.what: a USD rate shown as the CREDIT input rate
cases: CREDIT-RATE: the credit regime shows the approved card in CREDIT only, never a USD figure

mutants.what: a provisional card presented as approved
cases: CREDIT-RATE: the credit regime shows the approved card in CREDIT only, never a USD figure
a provisional card is reported as provisional, so no page can present it as approved

mutants.what: legacy USD figures labelled as CREDIT
cases: SPLIT-CONTRACT: the legacy regime shows its USD price identity only, never a converted CREDIT

mutants.what: the hold truncates instead of rounding up
cases: the hold is P-01's arithmetic: 14.7456 at the caps, less with a smaller max_tokens, rounded up

mutants.what: the disclosure hard-codes the input rate
cases: P-01: the charge disclosure is the decided text, with the card's own rates

mutants.what: platform timeouts drop out of the never-charged list
mutants.find: "requests that time out on our side;",
cases: P-01: the charge disclosure is the decided text, with the card's own rates

mutants.what: revocation claims reads stop immediately
mutants.find: Reads and cancels by that key stop within 60 seconds
mutants.replace: Reads and cancels by that key stop immediately
cases: P-26: the revocation copy is the decided text

mutants.what: retention copy claims zero data retention
mutants.find: This is not zero data retention.
cases: retention says what serving stores and for how long, and that trace-off is not deletion
no rendered sentence carries a stale or false claim

mutants.what: the result lifetime is a constant, not the record's
mutants.replace: A result stays readable for 24 hours
cases: retention says what serving stores and for how long, and that trace-off is not deletion

mutants.what: trace-off claimed to delete serving data
mutants.find: Turning it off does not delete the serving data above
mutants.replace: Turning it off deletes the serving data above
cases: retention says what serving stores and for how long, and that trace-off is not deletion

mutants.what: live video claimed supported
mutants.find:
v.live_stream
      ? "Live video streams are accepted."
      : "Live video streams are not supported: send a finished clip. Streaming applies to the text output only."
cases: the video contract is the record's: 82 s, one clip, 64 MiB, no live stream

mutants.what: the duration cap is a constant
cases: the video contract is the record's: 82 s, one clip, 64 MiB, no live stream

mutants.what: insufficient_credit documented at the wrong status
cases: every error row is the gateway's code at the gateway's HTTP status

mutants.what: a route the gateway does not serve is documented
cases: every documented route is in the gateway's route table

mutants.what: an example sends an unsupported parameter
mutants.find: -d '${chatBody(model, null, "In one sentence, what is dense video captioning?").json()}'
mutants.replace: -d '${chatBody(model, null, "In one sentence, what is dense video captioning?").json(', "tools": []')}'
cases: every example runs as written in curl, Python and JavaScript and prints its answer
the three languages make exactly the same requests for each example
every chat body names only advertised parameters, an alias of the model and an in-cap max_tokens

mutants.what: an example sends a header outside the API vocabulary
cases: every example runs as written in curl, Python and JavaScript and prints its answer
the three languages make exactly the same requests for each example
every request is a route of the gateway's table with only its header vocabulary

mutants.what: an example calls a route that does not exist
cases: every example runs as written in curl, Python and JavaScript and prints its answer

mutants.what: the examples name a model the catalog does not publish
cases: every example runs as written in curl, Python and JavaScript and prints its answer
every chat body names only advertised parameters, an alias of the model and an in-cap max_tokens

mutants.what: the async example asks /v1/jobs to stream
mutants.find:
const accepted = await api("POST", "/v1/jobs", { body: item, headers: { "Idempotency-Key": "clip-0001" } });
if (accepted.status !== 202)
mutants.replace:
const accepted = await api("POST", "/v1/jobs", { body: { ...item, stream: true }, headers: { "Idempotency-Key": "clip-0001" } });
if (accepted.status !== 202)
cases: every example runs as written in curl, Python and JavaScript and prints its answer

mutants.what: the Docs page renders without an unavailable branch
cases: an unavailable catalog renders its fixed copy and no figure

mutants.what: the Models page reads the old public.models table
mutants.replace:
await supabase.from("models").select("*");
  const { data: keys } = await supabase
cases: the pages read only the published catalog: no public.models table, no USD columns, no stale copy
